program.name: soltoshidiceBank
docs: Decode-only IDL for verified mainnet source e875a74a72af04b0bb203ac2952401e2eb0cef0c. Native Borsh account layouts and instruction payloads; no Anchor discriminator is prepended.

Instruction account roles are intentionally not inferred. For transaction construction, use the maintained game/chain client builders and verified Rust validation. This IDL is not a replacement for those clients.
Accounts sharing the same byte length can be ambiguous; inspect their PDA derivation and owner against the verified Rust source before using decoded fields.
